title: Console: an "App lock" entry on the profile page when the mobile shell exposes openAppLockSettings()
body:
repo:mobile#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnW1Xf6HDSWz1eGAqv

Filing category ③: a direct task from a maintainer ruling. The ruling is objectstack-ai/mobile#145 comment 6593856498: `Ruling: batch #1 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」`. Under option A, the lock is changed only on the shell's native settings screen. The Console reads it and opens that screen; it never writes the lock.

## What the shell offers

The shell side is objectstack-ai/mobile#181; the contract is in mobile `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md`, section "App lock".

- **`getAppLock()`** resolves `{ enabled: boolean, timeoutSeconds: number }`.
- **`openAppLockSettings()`** opens the native settings screen. Changing the setting there asks for biometrics.
- Feature-detect each with `has('getAppLock')` and `has('openAppLockSettings')`. Only pages on the configured server's origin may call them.
- No event announces a change. Re-read `getAppLock()` when the profile page is shown.

## Ask (Console, `ui/`)

- On the user profile / personal settings page, when `has('openAppLockSettings')`, show an "App lock" row with its current state from `getAppLock()`. Tapping it calls `openAppLockSettings()`.
- In a plain browser or an older shell, show nothing.
- ⛔ No Console-side toggle. The ruling keeps all writes native.

## Business reason

- **Who benefits:** phone users who expect the lock under their profile settings, where other apps put it.
- **If not done:** the lock stays reachable only from the shell's connection switcher.

## Who acts

The `domain:ui` seat. Triage decides the grade.

## Duplicate check (2026-11-03)

`is:issue openAppLockSettings` in this repo returns 0 hits.
